analysis.reasonEn: Recent 3-session downtrend confirmed, RSI entering oversold. MACD histogram worsening suggests further downside potential. ADX at 23.6 in early trend formation phase, awaiting directional confirmation. 5-day low at 170,000 KRW, below 20-day low of 170,000 KRW, hinting at Lower Low pattern. Approaching lower Bollinger Band and RSI oversold entry offer technical bounce potential, but MACD deterioration and weak ADX warrant a wait-and-see approach for buys.
